2306-0103 Unexpected error.
For example, this occurs when an application calls an unauthorized asynchronous process		 1.
Check the implementation of your application and your requests to use features on OMAS, and then contact Nintendo.

2.
If you use NMAS2, you can check the application's history of calls to asynchronous processes.

3.
To improve security, Nintendo sometimes eliminates asynchronous processes that are not documented in the API reference.
For example, Nintendo eliminated some of the asynchronous processes for matchmaking in February of 2023. For more information about that, see the following announcement.

2306-0112 This error occurs in any of the following situations.

1.
When there is no communication response within the prescribed time.

2.
When the application's implementation of asynchronous processing without communication using the NEX mechanism (nn::nex::CallContext) has not finished within the prescribed time.
It is rare for applications to use this kind of implementation.
If there is concern that inconsistency with the error message will cause user confusion, handle the error as needed and do not display the message in the error viewer applet.		 • Please wait and try again later.

2306-0502 Could not establish a connection with the game server. This error occurs in any of the following situations.

If the error is not due an any of these causes and the problem is not resolved by waiting and trying again, use a method like the OMAS message board to contact Nintendo and request an investigation and a reboot.
At that time, clearly specify your game server ID and server environment (for example, dd1).

=====
1.
Communication with the game server failed.
The following issues are the main reasons for failing.

---
• There is a problem with the LAN or Internet connection that the Switch console is connected to, and the signal cannot reach the game server.
• The DNS server configured for the Switch console has an inappropriate record cached.
• There is a problem with the DNS servers managed by Nintendo.
• There is a problem with the lp1 game server (outage other than scheduled maintenance).
• Performance is not ensured for this combination of the SDK version used to build the application and the NEX library version.
• The NEX version used to build the application does not match the NEX library version submitted on OMAS.
---


2.
The application has passed the wrong access key to the argument of the nn::nex::NgsFacade::Login() function.


3.
The game server is stopped for some reason.
The game server startup status can be checked by accessing NMAS2.
The following issues are the main reasons for stoppage.

---
3-A.
A server other than lp1 (dd1/sd1/sp1/jd1/td1) is undergoing maintenance.
https://developer.nintendo.com/group/development/home/network-status

3-B.
Nintendo stopped the game server because there was a certain period of time with no access from the development hardware.
https://developer.nintendo.com/group/development/g1kr9vj6/tech-info/announcement?articleId=295095953

3-C.
Nintendo improperly set up the game server. Or, the game server was mistakenly stopped.
---

Around 2018, you could access NMAS (NMAS1) and click a button to restart a stopped game server.
However, that button no longer works.

Vérifiez ces paramètres en sélectionnant  (Paramètres de la console) dans le menu HOME, puis Internet.

Si vous utilisez une connexion sans fil, il est possible que le signal soit perturbé.
Essayez de :
・rapprocher la console du point d'accès;
・retirer tout obstacle entre le point d'accès et la console.

Si le problème persiste, vérifiez si vous parvenez à accéder à Internet depuis un autre appareil (ordinateur, etc.).		 Não foi possível estabelecer uma conexão à internet.

É possível que a configuração do servidor DNS ou do servidor proxy esteja incorreta.
Verifique as configurações nas configurações do console (), a partir do menu HOME, e selecione "Internet".

Se uma conexão sem fio estiver sendo usada, a intensidade do sinal pode estar fraca.
Para melhorar o sinal, tente o seguinte:
・Aproxime o console do ponto de acesso.
・Verifique se não há obstruções entre o console e o ponto de acesso.

Se mesmo assim não for possível estabelecer uma conexão, verifique se outros dispositivos ou um computador estão conectados à internet.		 Could not connect to the internet.

The DNS setting or proxy server may have been entered incorrectly.
Check the setting by going to HOME Menu ⇒  (System Settings) ⇒ Internet.

If you are using a wireless connection, the wireless signal strength
may be poor.
Try the following solutions:
・Move the console closer to the network device.
・Remove any obstacles between the network device and the console.

If you are still unable to connect, check whether you can access the internet from your PC or other devices.		 La connexion à Internet a échoué.

Il se peut que les paramètres DNS ou du serveur proxy soient incorrects.
Vérifiez ces paramètres en sélectionnant  (paramètres de la console) dans le menu HOME, puis Internet.

Si le problème persiste, vérifiez si vous parvenez à accéder à Internet depuis un autre appareil (ordinateur, etc.).		 Es konnte keine Verbindung zum Internet hergestellt werden.

Möglicherweise wurden die DNS-Einstellungen des Proxy-Servers nicht korrekt eingetragen.
Bitte überprüfe die Einstellungen. Wähle hierfür HOME-Menü ⇒
 (Systemeinstellungen) ⇒ Internet aus.

Wenn du eine drahtlose Verbindung verwendest, ist die drahtlose Signalstärke möglicherweise zu schwach.
Bitte versuche Folgendes:
・Bewege die Konsole näher an das Netzwerkgerät heran.
・Entferne alle Hindernisse zwischen Netzwerkgerät und Konsole.

Wenn immer noch keine Verbindung möglich ist, überprüfe, ob du mit deinem PC oder anderen Geräten eine Verbindung zum Internet herstellen kannst.		 No se ha podido establecer la conexión a internet.

Es posible que la información de los servidores DNS o del servidor
proxy no sea correcta.
Para comprobarlo, abre el menú HOME, accede a la configuración
de la consola () y selecciona "Internet".

Si estás utilizando una conexión inalámbrica, es posible que la señal
sea débil.
Para mejorar la recepción de la señal, prueba lo siguiente:
・Acerca la consola al dispositivo de red.
・Retira los obstáculos que pudiera haber
entre el dispositivo de red y la consola.

Si la conexión sigue sin establecerse, comprueba que tengas acceso
a internet desde un ordenador u otro dispositivo.		 Impossibile collegarsi a Internet.

Le impostazioni dei DNS o del server proxy potrebbero essere sbagliate.
Controlla le impostazioni accedendo a Impostazioni di sistema () ⇒ Internet dal menu HOME.

Se si sta utilizzando una connessione wireless, il segnale di ricezione potrebbe essere troppo debole.
L'intensità del segnale potrebbe essere migliorata nei seguenti modi:
・Avvicina la console al dispositivo di rete.
・Rimuovi ogni ostacolo fra il dispositivo di rete e la console.

Se si presentassero ancora problemi di connessione, verifica se è possibile collegarsi a Internet dal tuo PC o da altri dispositivi.		 Er kan geen verbinding worden gemaakt met het internet.

De DNS- of proxyserverinstellingen zijn mogelijk onjuist ingevoerd.
Controleer je instellingen via HOME-menu ⇒  (systeeminstellingen) ⇒ INTERNET.

Wanneer je een draadloze verbinding gebruikt, is het signaal misschien te zwak.
Probeer het volgende:
・Plaats het systeem dichter bij het netwerkapparaat.
・Zorg dat er zich tussen het systeem en het netwerkapparaat geen obstakels bevinden.

Als dit probleem zich blijft voordoen, controleer dan of andere apparaten, zoals een pc, wel verbinding met het internet kunnen maken.		 Não foi possível estabelecer ligação à Internet.

Se estiveres a utilizar uma ligação sem fios, é possível que a intensidade do sinal sem fios seja fraca.
Tenta as seguintes soluções:
・Colocar a consola mais perto do dispositivo de rede;
・Remover quaisquer obstáculos entre o dispositivo de rede e a consola.

Se o problema persistir, verifica se consegues aceder à Internet a partir de um PC ou de outro dispositivo.		 Не удалось подключиться к Интернету.

ニンテンドーeショップで、くわしい情報を見ることができます｡

すでに加入している場合は、電源メニュー（電源ボタンを3秒長押し）の「電源オプション」から本体を再起動して、もう一度おためしください｡		 需要加入Nintendo Switch Online。

在Nintendo eShop中可以查看详细信息。

如果已加入，请在电源菜单（长按电源键3秒）的“电源选项”中重启主机，然后再试一次。		 必須加入Nintendo Switch Online。

可在Nintendo eShop查看詳細資訊。

若已加入，請到電源選單（長按電源鍵3秒）的「電源選項」重新啟動主機，再次嘗試。		 Nintendo Switch Online에 가입이 필요합니다.

닌텐도 e숍에서 자세한 정보를 볼 수 있습니다.

이미 가입했을 경우, 전원 메뉴(전원 버튼 3초간 누르기)의 「전원 옵션」에서 본체를 재기동하고 다시 시도해 주십시오.		 需要加入Nintendo Switch Online。

在Nintendo e商店中可以查看详细信息。
